name: Screenplay / script
description: A film, TV, or stage script in prose-markdown format, with characters and scene structure.

tone: [the film's tone — e.g. deadpan / tense / warm]
avoid: novelistic interiority (we can't film a thought)
prefer: action described in the present tense
rules.povConsistency: Objective — we only see and hear what the camera does
rules.dialogueStyle: Each character has a distinct rhythm and vocabulary; keep lines lean
revisionFocus: check each scene has a turn
rules.customInstructions: This is a script written in markdown. Convention for this room: a scene heading is an H2 slugline like "## INT. KITCHEN — NIGHT"; character cues are bold (e.g. **MAYA**) with dialogue on the next line; action lines are plain present-tense paragraphs. The editor is prose-markdown, so treat this as a formatting convention, not industry-standard screenplay software. Keep dialogue and action visual and filmable.

characters.name: [Lead]
characters.description: [Who they are and what they want in this story.]
characters.arc: [What changes for them by the last scene.]

threads.name: [A-story]
threads.summary: [The main dramatic line the script follows.]

profile.summary: [The script's voice — how the action lines read, how the dialogue sounds.]
